about: Auto Answer decider: ModernBERT-base (149.6M) student yt2, distilled from the Laya teacher r3 (alpha 0.7, 4 epochs) on the 117k synthetic rows plus 6,934 real-call moments from public YouTube interviews and sales calls (Claude Opus 5.5 labels). Paid, private download (API keys + Pro): int8 per-channel with reduced range on onnxruntime 1.24.3 (Windows, Apple Silicon macOS 14+; student 1's full-range int8 broke on x86), 4-bit MatMulNBits on the app onnxruntime 1.22 (Intel Macs, macOS 13). Gold (int8, onnxruntime 1.24.3): alone 32/34 asks, 0/153 false fires; with the LLM judge below the cut-off 32/34, 1/153. Real-call test (627 moments, 8 held-out videos): 88.8% answer-vs-not. ml/auto-answer-decider, docs/autopilot/decider-decisions.md.
